topic: Lewis Henry Morgan's Classification of Kinship Terminology
questionText: In his pioneering 1871 masterpiece 'Systems of Consanguinity and Affinity of the Human Family', Lewis Henry Morgan divided all global kinship systems into two fundamental categories:

options.text: Classificatory Systems and Descriptive Systems

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:

Morgan distinguished Classificatory systems (which lump lineal and collateral relatives under a single term) from Descriptive systems (which use distinct descriptive terms).
